target: N-02: ECAPA-TDNN cosine, clone vs held-out remainder of the same recording; > 85% (M1), > 90% (final)
method: scripts/measure_clone_similarity.py split: first 30 s of inputs/ljspeech_reference.wav as the prompt, the last ~20 s held out; ECAPA via SpeechQualityAuditor (CPU)

attempts.name: kNN-VC on the XTTS clone (WavLM-Large layer 6, k-NN over the 30 s prompt, prematched HiFi-GAN; implemented locally, no upstream code run)
OpenVoice V2 tone-colour converter applied to the XTTS clone, tau 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8
Long-term average spectrum of the clone matched to the prompt (alpha 0.5 / 1.0, max +-12 dB)
Best of 4 XTTS candidates per sentence, picked by ECAPA similarity to the PROMPT (never the held-out audio)
attempts.why: +2 to +4 points for 4x synthesis time; changes no tier

conclusion: No change reached 85%. The best single result is 67.3% (best-of-4). The 90% target is 98% of the same speaker's own real speech (91.7%). A stronger cloning model, not post-processing or sampling, is the only route left.
